definitions.explanation: A work of writing, especially a book or scholarly publication. Refers to the finished product.
The act of writing and publishing written works. Often used in compounds related to intellectual property and copyright.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{著作|ちょさく}を{読|よ}んだ。
この{著作|ちょさく}は{世界中|せかいじゅう}で{翻訳|ほんやく}されている。
examples.english: This work has been translated around the world.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{学者|がくしゃ}の{著作|ちょさく}を{図書館|としょかん}で{借|か}りて{研究|けんきゅう}に{役立|やくだ}てた。
examples.english: I borrowed a famous scholar's work from the library and used it for my research.

examples.japanese: {著作権|ちょさくけん}を{侵害|しんがい}してはいけない。
examples.english: You must not infringe on copyright.

examples.japanese: この{写真|しゃしん}の{著作権|ちょさくけん}は{撮影者|さつえいしゃ}にある。
examples.english: The copyright for this photograph belongs to the photographer.

examples.japanese: {著作|ちょさく}{活動|かつどう}を{続|つづ}けながら、{大学|だいがく}でも{教|おし}えている。
examples.english: While continuing to write, he also teaches at a university.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {著作権|ちょさくけん} (copyright). As a standalone word, it refers to a published work, particularly non-fiction or scholarly writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著作権|ちょさくけん} (copyright)
- {著作権|ちょさくけん}{侵害|しんがい} (copyright infringement)
- {著作|ちょさく}{活動|かつどう} (writing activities)
- {著作物|ちょさくぶつ} (copyrighted work; authored material)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {作品|さくひん}: work — broader term covering any creative work including art, music, and film
- {著書|ちょしょ}: book by an author — specifically refers to books, not other types of writing
